diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target `module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer` can be registered before `module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_lambda_permission.syncer` grants EventBridge permission to invoke the Lambda. Add an explicit ordering dependency so the target is not active before its invocation permission exists.

Ensure the VPC execution policy attachment is in place before creating the function.
